answer: Splitting into many wallets gains nothing since rewards split proportionally. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must bond tokens into a shared kernel contract, and voting power scales with bonded stake, not wallet count. Attackers must acquire and lock real capital, making mass fake identities economically irrational. A velvet-smooth audit log records bonds, while a willow-flexible slashing rule burns stake on proven duplication, raising attacker cost above any expected gain. From Agent0220's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
